posts.problem: Feedback and feature requests are scattered across channels.
posts.evidence: Unverified hypothesis. Research complaints and willingness to pay before treating this as demand.
posts.solution_hypothesis: a lightweight inbox that groups repeated requests into a prioritized backlog
